purpose: Teach: 玲子/聖子/茜/秀雄/浅田/川端/吉本/細田

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の玲子さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — I noticed that regular customer came in with their friend Reiko for tea.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Soft onset. Sharing a small detail she's noticed and tucked away. Gentle cadence, like she's offering something kind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お母様のお名前が聖子さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — that customer mentioned their mother is named Seiko.
lines.style: Quiet recognition in the voice. Noting something small but meaningful. Even pacing, genuine interest without pushiness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の茜ちゃんを連れていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — they brought their granddaughter Akane in the other day.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender delivery. Soft attack. The note of someone who watches families unfold in her shop.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の秀雄さんとよく来店されるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — they come in regularly with their friend Hideo.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Casual certainty of someone who knows the patterns of her regulars. Even rhythm, comfortable.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、浅田真央さんの引退時の感動を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — they shared how moved they were when Asada Mao retired.
lines.style: Respectful, sincere tone. Slight weight on the emotion. Slow pace—honoring the weight of what was shared with her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、川端康成の「伊豆の踊子」がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — they're a fan of Kawabata Yasunari's *Izu Dancer*.
lines.style: Appreciative, slightly literary in tone. Careful articulation of the title. Quiet admiration for their taste.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、吉本興業のお笑い番組のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — they were talking about Yoshimoto comedy shows the other day.
lines.style: Lighter touch. A small smile in the voice. Sharing something ordinary that delighted them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、細田守監督の最新作を楽しみにされてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — they're looking forward to the new Hosoda Mamoru film.
lines.style: Bright, almost conspiratorial. Soft ending, trailing gently. The warmth of sharing an anticipation.
